required_before_use: Install optuna only for research runs; never required for live/paper execution.
Train/test must be time-ordered; random shuffle is not allowed for trading systems.
Optimized parameters must improve or hold up in the unseen test half.
Strategy timing must beat a random entry baseline inside the same regime pool.
No optimized variant can be promoted before at least 30-50 closed trades.
NERO can recommend parameter changes, but cannot silently auto-change live/paper strategy parameters.
